subject: english
question: What should come in the place of blank number (5)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**performative**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The final sentence warns that without democratic scrutiny, the surveillance state creates "not safety but a simulated solidarity."
 
• Because the solidarity is "simulated" (fake or acted out), the "submission" of the citizens to this system is also done for show, merely to satisfy the algorithms and metrics of the state.
 
• "**Performative**" means relating to an action done primarily for show or to project a certain image. It perfectly pairs with "simulated," indicating that citizens are merely acting out their compliance to avoid being labeled as anomalies.
 
• Other options do not capture the artificial, acted-out nature of this forc
